purpose: Prevent autonomous product work from confusing attractive output, architecture quality or passing tests with a world-class rendered experience.

experience_specialists.owned_truth: A busy first-time user can say what matters, why it matters and what to do next without decoding product language.
veto_examples: more than one competing primary action
the Brain makes the user perform the interpretation
explanatory furniture is required to understand the question
desktop or mobile hierarchy hides the consequential decision

experience_specialists.owned_truth: The sequence, controls, feedback and recovery make the valuable action feel obvious, low-effort and impossible to lose.
veto_examples: a control does not look or behave interactive
the verdict is separated from the action that produced it
input can disappear or cannot be resumed
progressive disclosure becomes hidden required work

experience_specialists.owned_truth: The surface is recognisably Mindmake, aesthetically exceptional and meaningfully distinct from prevailing AI-product defaults.
veto_examples: visual novelty has no informational meaning
generic AI gradients, glass cards, mascot theatre or sparkle grammar
pompous display copy consumes useful space
the experience is polished but interchangeable

experience_specialists.owned_truth: The product feels thoughtful, calm, encouraging and accountable without arrogance, manipulation, fake intimacy or verbal excess.
veto_examples: AI-written swagger or bossy fragment stacks
reassurance repeated instead of value delivered
a hard question feels accusatory or incomprehensible
anthropomorphism obscures agency or accountability

experience_specialists.owned_truth: The same task and status survive the intended device, viewport, orientation, pointer, keyboard, voice, zoom and browser conditions.
veto_examples: mobile is a squeezed desktop
touch, safe areas, virtual keyboards or dynamic browser chrome break the task
meaning depends on hover
device handoff loses state or changes authority

experience_specialists.owned_truth: Keyboard, assistive technology, focus, semantics, contrast, reflow and reduced-motion behavior preserve the complete task and consequence.
veto_examples: keyboard or screen-reader users cannot complete the primary task
focus is lost or trapped incorrectly
color, motion or spatial position carries unique meaning
zoom or text reflow hides controls or content

experience_specialists.owned_truth: Loading, model latency, animation and transitions feel intentional, responsive and alive without hiding delay or degrading control.
veto_examples: two loading experiences occur back to back
animation is decorative, janky or incompatible with reduced motion
slow AI work has no honest progress, cancellation, fallback or retry
layout shift or input delay damages trust

experience_specialists.owned_truth: Representative, sparse, empty, long, stale, loading, failed and adversarial states remain useful and honest, and AI output never outruns evidence.
veto_examples: synthetic or sparse data produces a business horoscope
failure destroys work or encourages duplicate action
generated imagery or visualisation implies unsupported meaning
the happy path is polished while real edge cases collapse

proof_layers.contract: Machine checks prove exact files, schemas, state transitions and declared invariants only.
proof_layers.rendered: Browser evidence proves observable behavior for named tasks, revisions, states and viewports only.
proof_layers.reality: Fresh people, physical devices and assistive technology prove comprehension and use; emulation and AI judges cannot substitute for this layer.
proof_layers.outcome: Longitudinal customer evidence proves decision value, habit, trust and improvement; no UI review can infer it.

required_pack: sanitized user, job and product promise
non-negotiable product, data, safety and brand constraints
named tasks, states, viewports and evidence
current-source standards packet where the requirement may have changed

historical_second_pass.purpose: Calibrate against recurring failure without anchoring the independent first pass.
historical_second_pass.cross_examination: Standards prosecution and veto defense attack each sealed verdict before adjudication.

required: explicit statement that no rendered-experience approval was inferred

release_candidate.physical_device_evidence: actual iOS Safari and Android Chrome for release-critical mobile flows

reality_labs.tasks: three to seven highest-value tasks unless the scope is deliberately narrower
browser_floor: Firefox where browser risk is material
responsive_floor: intermediate or tablet width when the layout changes materially
portrait and landscape where the task may occur
input_floor: voice plus a non-voice alternative where voice is offered
reality_labs.performance_rule: Use current authoritative thresholds at test time and record the source, retrieval date, environment and observed distribution.

futuristic_quality_definition: The system feels prepared before the user asks.
Complex intelligence appears as one calm, meaningful next move.
Visualisation carries truth and consequence rather than decorative theatre.
The product is recognisable and memorable without borrowing current AI fashion.
Motion and responsiveness make the Brain feel alive without impersonating a person.
A leader becomes more capable, not more dependent or busier.
